name: FRED API (St. Louis Fed)

provider.name: Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis

summary: 800,000+ US and international economic time series (GDP, CPI, unemployment, rates); free API key required.
description: Federal Reserve Economic Data: macro series from 100+ sources including BLS, BEA, Census, OECD and IMF. Endpoints for series metadata, observations, categories, releases, tags and search; ALFRED vintage data is supported. A free key comes with a FRED account.

auth.notes: Free key (32-character lowercase alphanumeric) from a fred.stlouisfed.org account. Add file_type=json for JSON.

example.response_excerpt: {"error_code": 400, "error_message": "Bad Request.  The value for variable api_key is not a 32 character alpha-numeric lower-case string."}

license.name: Terms vary per series; many public domain, some copyrighted by the source; FRED API terms apply

agent_notes: Always add file_type=json (default is XML). Find a series_id via /series/search, then call /series/observations; units= and frequency= transform values server-side.
caveats: Only the JSON error response for an invalid key was verified; no authenticated call was made.
CORS was not confirmed: the error response carried no access-control header.

verification.notes: Executed with a placeholder key; HTTP 400 JSON error confirms the endpoint, no real key was used.
